Projects in development include intelligent modular UPS for future intelligent-computing centers, high-density high-power modular UPS, a high-density Huiyun modular data center, an intelligent liquid-cooling CDU (large single-cabinet cooling, DC input architecture) aimed at top internet companies and large data centers, and an HVDC power system that addresses GPU load fluctuation; a discrete HVDC system for AI computing clusters and intelligent-computing centers was completed.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Data-center power products (annual report): the 100kW UPS power module is in volume production; in 2025 the company launched what it calls the world's first 200kW high-density UPS module and received a 1.2MW UPS (200kW module) certificate from the TLC certification center, with power density of 47W/in3, which it says is 20% above the industry level. Its new-generation prefabricated power-module solution cuts footprint by 30%, electrical loss by 20% and deployment time by 60%; a state-owned bank's Shanghai data center (which it calls the largest power-module project in China's finance industry) has taken delivery of dozens of sets. The skid version for export is rated 2.4MW with 120kW of matching cooling, enough for 60 IT cabinets at 40kW each using H100 chips (about 130P FP32). Its DC products cover 240V, 400V and 800V, and it is developing solid-state transformers (SST) for next-generation intelligent-computing-center power.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Co-developed products (annual report, FY2025): the elastic DC integrated cabinet co-developed with a major internet company for AIDC load profiles has been delivered in more than 2000 units; the company also co-developed a DC STS static transfer switch with a major internet company and a minimal UPS with Kuaishou, plus new UPS products with several leading companies for power-module skids going overseas; its integrated solution, which supplies both AC and DC from one power platform, is adapted to a major internet company's LC-MDC. Its WiseMDC liquid-cooled POD reaches 40-120kW per cabinet with PUE as low as 1.15, and the Huiyun 7.0 modular data center reaches PUE 1.2 with 99% full-load UPS efficiency and 2.5-day delivery.
quarterly_data.figure: Elastic DC integrated cabinet: more than 2000 units delivered

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (annual report): the company has six manufacturing bases, in Xiamen, Zhangzhou, Malaysia and elsewhere; in 2025 efficiency gains raised new-energy factory capacity to 68GW per year and shortened delivery cycles for mainstream products, and the Malaysia factory build-out took initial shape as the base for overseas business.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New energy (annual report): by end-2025 cumulative global PV inverter shipments exceeded 68GW and cumulative global energy-storage installations exceeded 53GW; cumulative grid-forming storage PCS shipments exceeded 8GW; the company says its storage PCS shipments ranked first in China. 2025 launches included a 2000V 450kW string inverter and a liquid-cooled cluster-level storage PCS; projects delivered included the 1GW/4GWh grid-forming storage project in Arongqi, Inner Mongolia.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kehua Data annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress (annual report): CIP was RMB 333,419,730.16 at end-2025 (RMB 419,233,150.14 a year earlier). Major projects: Kehua Huiyun high-end equipment industrial park smart manufacturing base (phase I), budget RMB 736 million, balance RMB 148,442,370.04, 23.00% complete; Xiamen Shuneng Xiang'an base project, budget RMB 434,000,000.00, balance RMB 142,322,019.65, 21.00% complete; industrial park R&D center, budget RMB 146,000,000.00, 22.00% complete; the Beijing Yunzhu data center (budget RMB 347,000,000.00) reached 100% and RMB 379,693,367.46 was transferred to fixed assets. On November 28, 2025 the board postponed the ready-for-use date of the raised-fund projects (smart manufacturing base phase I, R&D center, digital enterprise) to December 31, 2028 and added Zhangzhou, Fujian as a co-location of the smart manufacturing base; by end-2025 RMB 11,768.38 ten-thousand of the base's RMB 73,634.19 ten-thousand was invested (15.98%).

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company outlook): the company will keep increasing investment in intelligent-computing-center infrastructure and solutions, develop new products for high-density computing, deepen cooperation with internet cloud providers and telecom operators and expand into finance, government and energy, strengthen localized delivery and service in Southeast Asia and Europe through its overseas manufacturing base, and raise the share of overseas business; it lists market competition, technology iteration, supply-chain disruption and receivable collection as risks.
